entries.text: Sentinel AI helps an operator interpret crop conditions, market signals, orders, resources, costs and verified outcomes. The assistant identifies evidence and suggests follow-up checks.
Operations and each scenario have separate run IDs, clocks and evidence cutoffs. A scenario changes the selected view while Operations continues on its own schedule.
A regional pest notice can prompt a scouting review. A plot assessment links the notice to local trap counts, images or scouting and records what still needs confirmation.
Compare prices at a matching fruit, grade, region, channel, package basis, currency and date. A published offer describes its listed terms. The signed contract is the source for that order’s price.
Track forecast eligibility, QA clearance, accepted harvest and reservation separately. Full-order release uses the required verified records and available, allocated quantities.
Compute usable harvest capacity from eligible crew and resource slots within the applicable harvest window. Recheck impacted allocations when a slot changes.
Distinguish gross contract value if fulfilled, modeled contribution and verified settlement. Cite the cost scope and quantity assumptions used in the calculation.
The application records approval against a specific revision and scope. Use the authorized workflow for dispatch and link execution receipts and verification to that revision.
